title: Quantum Density of States and Integer Partitions: A Semiclassical Approach
summary: In this review we discuss semi-classical methods that are traditionally used to describe many-body systems in physics, but may also be used to describe partitions of integers in analytic number theory. Specifically, we explore the connection between the methods of statistical mechanics and number partitions. Though the two fields appear very different, their fundamental issues bear a close resemblance.
